programs.title: Surya Kriya

programs.summary: “Surya” means “sun,” and “kriya” means “inner energy process.” Surya Kriya activates the solar plexus to raise the samat prana, or solar heat, in the system.

programs.title: Mantra Yoga
programs.location: Hotel & Café SIMON, Jormannsdorfer-Straße 15, 7431 Bad Tatzmannsdorf, Austria
programs.summary: Mantras are one of the most misunderstood aspects of Yoga. Sadhguru explains how a mantra is not just a sound that you utter but something that you strive to become.
